set.title: QRIS Top Up Tanpa Berbagi Nomor Akun
set.titleEn: QRIS Top Up Without Sharing Account Details
set.summary: Kebutuhannya sederhana. User harus bisa menerima top up dari orang lain tanpa mencari atau membagikan nomor akun. Saya mengadaptasi merchant-presented QRIS menjadi flow cash-in, merancang state transaksi bersama engineering, dan menjaga journey tetap singkat. Pada 2026, QRIS Top Up menyumbang 9.3% cash-in AstraPay dan menjadi salah satu dari dua channel terbesar.
set.summaryEn: The need was simple. Users should be able to receive a top up from someone else without finding or sharing account details. I adapted a merchant-presented QRIS pattern into a cash-in flow, worked through transaction states with engineering, and kept the visible journey short. By 2026, QRIS Top Up accounted for 9.3% of AstraPay cash-in and had become one of its top two channels.
